newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia's Privredna gets DM150 mln syndicated loan.
newsitem.headline: Croatia's Privredna gets DM150 mln syndicated loan.

text.p: Croatia's ailing Privredna Banka Zagreb said on Wednesday it got a 150 million German mark loan from a syndicate of foreign banks, led by Deutsche Bank AG.

"The lead manager had a great response for participation by foreign banks so the offered amount largely overshot the amount of credit sought by Privredna Banka Zagreb," the bank said in a news release.
It named 15 leading international banks as co-lead managers. The loan agreement will be signed in Zagreb on July 31.
The funds are repayable over five years with a three-year grace period, Privredna said. It described terms as "very favourable terms" without mentioning specifics.
The loan was intended for financing of "profitable projects of its clients". The bank services a large part of the public sector and most utilities.
Once the largest bank in Croatia, it is currently undergoing a radical overhaul under government supervision.
